title: Tiny, cute robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow on floor -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2b3a67' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body: round disc robot vacuum -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='16' fill='#8fd6ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='28' ry='15' fill='#b8ecff'/>
  <!-- top surface highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='20' ry='9' fill='#d8f6ff'/>
  <!-- edge bumper strip -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='28' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#4fa8dc' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- front bumper arc -->
  <path d='M22 62 A28 16 0 0 0 78 62' fill='none' stroke='#3f8ec2' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- friendly eyes on top -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='55' r='4' fill='#1a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='55' r='4' fill='#1a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='53.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='53.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M43 60 Q50 66 57 60' fill='none' stroke='#1a2a55' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- lidar bump on top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#7cc8ef'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#a5e3ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45.5' r='2' fill='#ffd34d'/>
  <!-- side brushes peeking out -->
  <g stroke='#ffd34d' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='20' y1='70' x2='12' y2='74'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='72' x2='14' y2='78'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='70' x2='88' y2='74'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='72' x2='86' y2='78'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny wheels -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='77' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3f8ec2'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='77' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3f8ec2'/>
</svg>
